roleTitle: Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for both residents and staff.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about fostering a culture of continuous learning and maintaining a safe, healthy environment. We offer a competitive hourly rate and the chance to make a significant impact within a supportive team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to nursing education and infection control
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 per hour.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, seeking dedicated Physical Therapists (PT), Occupational Therapists (OT), Speech-Language Pathologists (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA). We offer both full-time and part-time opportunities to fit your lifestyle, providing a supportive environment where you can make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.In this vital role, you will deliver high-quality therapy services, develop individualized treatment plans, and collaborate with a compassionate healthcare team to help residents achieve their maximum potential. We are committed to fostering a positive work culture and providing the resources you need to excel.This is an excellent opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic and rewarding setting.
requirements: Valid state licensure/certification as a PT, OT, ST, COTA, or PTA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
Ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $28.00 - $37.00 for COTA/PTA roles and $40.00 - $46.00 for PT/OT/ST roles, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate team focused on patient recovery and well-being.As a COTA, you will play a vital role in implementing individualized treatment plans under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. We are looking for a motivated professional eager to make a significant impact in a supportive environment.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing a stable and rewarding career path for a committed COTA.
requirements: Valid Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical skills and a commitment to patient-centered care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a Family Medicine Physician in Greenville, SC. We are seeking dedicated MDs or DOs to join a dynamic team, offering flexible Part-time, PRN, or Contract arrangements. This role provides a chance to make a significant impact while enjoying a highly competitive compensation package.

This position boasts a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, complemented by a robust bonus structure that can add up to $50,000 annually. This includes a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one, subject to a promissory note. The role also comes with great benefits and generous Paid Time Off.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Ability to work on a Part-time, PRN, or Contract basis
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation includes a non-negotiable base of $210,000 per year, with an additional $25,000 guaranteed bonus and $25,000 potential bonus, totaling up to $50,000. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one with a promissory note. Comprehensive benefits and generous Paid Time Off are also provided.
